task_name: Phase A /routing: fix round for review round 1 of PR 1063
description: Fixed the upheld findings C-01 to C-04 and C-06 to C-16 (plus info C-17, C-20, C-21, C-22) and the two red CI tests. A named live-detection entry point replaces the empty-list sentinel in /routing's loader; one shared connect verdict now feeds the predicate, the reason text and the picker rows; category fallback reasons use the Model tab's five words and the loader state; the session provider listed only as auth-failed still derives from the session model; unreachable, timed-out or unsupported providers with no list are shown on the Model tab and are not selectable; an empty refresh drops the older cache file; every flow 468 test is titled 'flow 468 AC<n>:'; the surviving mutants M-1 to M-3 and M-7 to M-12 are now killed. Follow-up: sixth reason "model list unavailable (<reason>)" per operator; docs/docs/cli-reference.md Live provider catalog section updated.
test_result: 260+ passed, 0 failed (table, routing-inspector, routing-classifier-source, commands/routing, spawn-subagent-tool, provider-catalog, cli-reference-coverage and the docs tests); earlier 254 across 11 files also passed. All 15 mutants killed.

noticed_not_touched.what: routing-classifier-source.ts still resolves with connectedPredicateFrom(providers) and no session argument (T6 left it for the same reason). With C-08 an auth-failed session provider derives a session-model assignment that the predicate then rejects, so the per-turn route falls back to the session model with a reason naming it. Harmless, but the session shortcut is not applied there.

keryx routing list (commands/routing.ts) and applyReviewRoutingCategory (commands/review.ts) still print the generic 'not connected' wording because they pass no provider list to describeRejectionNotice.

assumptions: A denied model id (isDeniedModel) is no longer offered as a picker row: the shared verdict says it is not connected, and an offered row that resolution would reject is the drift C-03 describes.
An unreachable, timed-out or unsupported provider with no list is not connected for resolution (a category assigned to it falls back), the same as when it was dropped from the list before.

behavior_changes.description: ANSWERED by the operator (question tool, 2026-10-20): «model list unavailable (Recommended)». A category assigned to a provider the Model tab shows as "<provider>: model list unavailable (<reason>)" now falls back saying "model list unavailable (<reason>)", the sixth reason; it no longer reuses "provider not connected".
alternatives: 'provider model list unavailable' as a sixth reason
'provider unreachable' carrying the status word (unreachable, timed out, no live listing)

behavior_changes.description: A denied model (the gdskills model denylist) is no longer listed in the Model tab picker, and a category assigned to one falls back with the generic 'not connected' (no dedicated reason word).
alternatives: Keep listing denied models in the picker (the old behaviour) and let resolution reject them

behavior_changes.description: A refresh that finds zero providers now deletes the on-disk provider catalog cache instead of leaving the previous non-empty file to be served until its TTL ends. `keryx providers status --refresh` after removing the last provider therefore clears the file.
alternatives: Write the empty result for force:true only

behavior_changes.description: The 'empty list is a request to detect live' rule stays for the shell's startup (tui-shell passes the empty detected list) but is now a named helper, detectedOrRedetected. /routing's loader no longer uses it: it calls the new loadOrRefreshProviderCatalogLive, which detects once and never re-detects an empty result.
alternatives: Add a redetect-as-source option to loadOrRefreshProviderCatalog itself

notes: suggested_fix diverged: C-01 — added loadOrRefreshProviderCatalogLive (named intent) instead of making loadOrRefreshProviderCatalog take redetect, so the startup path and the /routing path keep distinct entry points; the startup sentinel stays but is a named, documented helper. suggested_fix diverged: C-03 — one ConnectVerdict (connectVerdict/providerVerdict in table.ts) feeds connectedPredicateFrom, describeNotConnectedReason and flatModelOptions; the session shortcut stays in connectedPredicateFrom, so a rejected assignment never needed it in the reason. suggested_fix diverged: C-08 — a shared sessionDerivationModels(providers, session) used by both /routing and the per-turn classifier, falling back to [session.modelId] for any status-only row. suggested_fix diverged: C-09 — the status-row opt-in was renamed withAuthFailed -> withStatusRows (it now also returns listUnavailable rows) and FlatPickerProvider gained listUnavailable. C-05 dismissed by the operator: no negative cache added. C-12 to C-16 were reproduced as surviving mutants (mutation-1.md); all 15 mutants I re-ran after the fix (M-1, M-2 x2 variants, M-3, M-7 to M-12, C-06, C-07, C-08, C-11 and the opt-in) are KILLED. RoutingModalOptions gained a `catalog` test seam (dir, fetch, env) so the default loader path is testable without touching the real config dir. bun test exit code was 0 here.
